mathematical_scope.category: Set-valued local-action deformation functors on local Artinian W(k)-algebras; nilpotent constant terms allowed.
mathematical_scope.conclusion: Every proposed fibre-product map fails tangent surjectivity, hence cannot be formally smooth.
mathematical_scope.credit: The characteristic-two involution conjugacy is Byszewski-Cornelissen (2009), Proposition 4.1.
mathematical_scope.limits: No novelty or exhaustive-literature guarantee. Variants additionally assuming D_N/D_Q prorepresentable, pointed, framed or groupoid formulations are not addressed.
mathematical_scope.restriction: The tangent restriction from D_G to D_N is injective by the full formal-series equivariant derivation calculation.
mathematical_scope.undetectable_tangent: Every natural map D_Q to any prorepresentable F kills the same nonzero tangent v, by the j-fixed class over k[e]/e^3.
